title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Aceyteros street in the City of Manila to Marcelino De Santos.

text.en:
Aceyteros Street, in the City of Manila, shall hereafter be known as Marcelino de Santos Street,
to honor the memory of the illustrious, philanthropical Filipino Marcelino de Santos.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1928.
